items.name: NKD Long Sleeve Top - Cold Foam
items.description_en:
Sleek. Sculpted. Second-skin.
The NKD Long Sleeve Top is your elevated layering essential, designed to smooth, sculpt and move with you. Featuring a flattering cropped silhouette and fitted design, this long sleeve gym top contours your body with a sleek, second-skin feel that performs as good as it looks.
Crafted from our signature NKD fabric, it's buttery-soft, lightweight and breathable, keeping you comfortable through every workout, stretch and off-duty moment. The streamlined long sleeves add a refined, minimal edge, making it the perfect piece to wear.
Clean. Sculpted. On repeat.
Features
Cropped length for a flattering, on-trend fit
Fitted silhouette to smooth and contour
Long sleeves for added coverage and sleek styling
Signature NKD fabric for ultra-soft, second-skin comfort
Breathable and sweat-wicking
Minimal design for effortless styling
Perfect to pair with NKD leggings or shorts
Signature Ryderwear logo
Fabric: 87% Nylon, 13% Elastane
Model is 167cm tall. She usually wears a size XS and is wearing a size XS. Her bust measures 88cm and her waist measures 63cm.
Recommended for: Gym training, Pilates, yoga and everyday wear

A high-rise ribbed waistband supports and defines the waist, while strategic contour shading and a booty-enhancing scrunch seam create a lifted, sculpted look from every angle. Extra fabric coverage through the back keeps the fit squat-proof and confidence high, so you can train without distractions.
Strong support. Serious shape. Your new glute-day essential.

items.name: NKD Wide Leg Leggings - Black
items.description_en:
Meet your new on and off-duty obsession.
The NKD Wide Leggings are crafted from our signature buttery soft NKD fabric you already know and love, now reimagined in a relaxed, wide-leg silhouette that moves effortlessly from studio to street. Designed to sit smooth and flattering through the waist and hips before falling into a fluid wide leg, this style gives you that “put-together without trying” energy. Lightweight, breathable and second-skin soft, it’s the kind of legging you’ll reach for on repeat…. workouts optional.
Soft enough to lounge. Elevated enough to wear out. We understood the assignment.
Features
Signature NKD fabric for ultra-soft, second-skin comfort
Flattering mid to high-rise waistband that smooths and cinches
Relaxed wide-leg silhouette for effortless movement
Lightweight, breathable and non-restrictive feel
Two lengths available Regular and Tall because fit matters

items.name: Plush Trackpant - Charcoal
items.description_en:
The Plush Track Pant delivers the perfect oversized fit with premium heavyweight comfort you’ll never want to take off. Made from our ultra-soft brushed plush fleece, these track pants combine relaxed streetwear energy with the cosy feel of your favourite winter blanket.
Designed with a comfortable elastic waistband, oversized leg fit and cuffed ankle finish, the Plush Track Pant creates that effortless off-duty silhouette that works from gym runs to airport days and everything in between.
Warm, soft and easy to style, these are the track pants your entire winter wardrobe will revolve around.

Premium 410gsm heavyweight brushed plush fleece
Ultra-soft cosy feel
Relaxed oversized fit
Elastic waistband Side pockets
Ribbed cuff hems
Minimal elevated branding
Warm heavyweight feel
Easy everyday styling
Designed for lifestyle and lounge wear

items.name: Sculpt Seamless Leggings - Deep Blue
items.description_en:
The Sculpt Seamless Leggings are engineered to enhance your natural shape while delivering the support you need through every rep. Crafted from soft, compressive seamless fabric, they contour the body with a smooth, locked-in fit that moves effortlessly from heavy training sessions to off-duty plans.
A high-rise ribbed waistband supports and defines the waist, while strategic contour shading and a booty-enhancing scrunch seam create a lifted, sculpted look from every angle. Extra fabric coverage through the back keeps the fit squat-proof and confidence high, so you can train without distractions.
Strong support. Serious shape. Your new glute-day essential.
Key Features
Full-length seamless gym leggings
High-rise ribbed waistband
Booty-enhancing lift
Strategic contour shading to sculpt and define
Soft, compressive seamless fabric
Squat-proof design with added coverage through the back
Supportive, body-contouring fit
Stretch construction for unrestricted movement
True to size
65cm inner leg seam
Fabric
92% Polyamide / 8% Elastane
Model wears size S and is 170cm/5'7" tall.
Recommended For
Strength training, glute days, gym workouts and turning heads.

items.name: Aero Luxe Pants - Black
items.description_en:
The pant everyone's about to be obsessed with.
The Aero Lux Pant was designed to bring that effortlessly elevated, off-duty energy to your everyday wardrobe. Inspired by the relaxed tailoring trend taking over active and streetwear right now, this wide leg silhouette combines a lightweight drapey fabric with a sporty elastic waistband for the perfect balance of cool, comfort and polish.
Soft, flowy and ridiculously easy to style, these are the throw-on pants you'll wear from Pilates and coffee runs to airport days, errands and everything in between. The relaxed oversized fit creates that luxe, model-off-duty look, while the lightweight performance fabric keeps the feel breathable, smooth and comfortable all day long.
Pair them with a fitted crop, oversized hoodie or your favourite sports bra for the ultimate cool girl uniform.
Features
Lightweight luxe performance fabric
Relaxed wide leg silhouette
Soft drapey fit for effortless movement
Elastic Ryderwear branded waistband
Side pockets
Full length design
Easy throw-on styling piece
Elevated sporty aesthetic
Designed for lifestyle and everyday wear
Recommended for lifestyle, travel, recovery days and off-duty styling.
Main: 89% Polyester, 11% Elastane

items.name: Unisex Fleece Track Pant - Charcoal
items.description_en:
The everyday trackpant done properly.
The Unisex Fleece Track Pant is built for comfort you can wear anywhere. Made from premium brushed fleece, these trackpants deliver warmth, softness and that relaxed oversized fit that works perfectly on rest days, gym days and everything in between.
Designed with cuffed ankles and a clean tapered shape, they balance comfort with a polished off-duty look. Pair them with matching fleece layers for the full set energy.
Features:
 Relaxed unisex track pant fit
 Premium brushed fleece interior
 Elastic waistband with adjustable drawcord
 Side pockets for essentials
 Ribbed cuffed ankles
 Warm soft feel for colder weather
 Easy everyday styling piece
Recommended for: Lifestyle, lounge and recovery days
This garment is in men's sizing. Women are recommended to size down for a true fit.

* Squat-proof with added coverage in all the right places
* Soft, compressive seamless fabric for a second-skin feel
* Full length fit
* True to size fit that moves with you

items.name: Patriot 1 TAA Replacement Lace Set (Black)
items.description_en:
Built as a direct replacement for the original Patriot 1 speed lace system, this kit includes everything needed to quickly restore fit, function, and performance without replacing the entire boot. Whether your laces have worn out from hard use, repeated field work, training cycles, or daily duty wear, this replacement kit gets you back up and running fast.

Designed to mirror the original quick-lace configuration, the kit includes precut replacement laces, lace keeper, and rubber pull tab for a secure fit and rapid adjustment on the move. The system allows for fast tightening, reliable tension retention, and easy stowing of excess lace in the boot’s lace pocket.

items.name: Gadsden Flag Tee (Black)
items.description_en: Dating back to the Revolutionary War period when it was originally referenced by Benjamin Franklin as the symbol of American spirit, this flag represented the American defiance as we fought for our independence. As a veteran-owned company, this symbol holds significance for our brand. And we’re proud to have the symbol of the American spirit displayed on one of our most-loved t-shirt designs.

Colonel Christopher Gadsden of the Continental Marines brought this flag out on the water for our country's first naval mission and presented it to the Commodore of the Navy to fly in the formation. Today, the Gadsden symbol is still worn as an official patch on the left shoulder of naval uniforms, and it pays homage to our forefathers who were bold and daring enough to fight for their independence and establish the freedoms we enjoy today. Order this Gadsden flag shirt for yourself.

items.name: Men's Frontier Pant 2.0 (Coyote Brown)
items.description_en:
Heavyweight, functional, and durable backcountry trousers.  Versatility ranges from warm climates to extreme cold when paired with our layering system.

The Frontier 2.0, is the perfect combination of function, fit, and durability. Engineered from fabric that is flexible enough to move without hindrance and durable enough to stand up to anything you may encounter in the field.  Featuring a warm but breathable 4-way stretch fabric with side zip vents, internal knee pad pockets, a water-repellent finish, reinforcements on the knees, seat, and heel, a truly versatile pocket system,  and a dialed-in athletic fit for unrestricted mobility.

Conditions: 60°F to Frigid

items.name: Mission FLEX Rain Pant 2.0 (Black)
items.description_en:
A durable waterproof shell pant designed for unrestricted mobility, weather protection, and all-day comfort in demanding environments.

The Mission FLEX Rain Pant 2.0 combines the proven waterproof protection of eVent® stormST technology with an updated fit and functional improvements driven by real-world field feedback. Designed for outdoor professionals operating in wet, cold, and unpredictable conditions, these pants provide reliable protection without the stiff, restrictive feel of traditional rain gear.

The updated 2.0 fit improves mobility and comfort during extended wear, while the addition of a boot lace hook retention system keeps the pant securely positioned during hiking, climbing, and crouched movement. Full-length side zips allow for rapid layering and ventilation without removing boots, making these pants ideal for changing mountain conditions and fast-moving weather systems.

Ideal for cool to frigid conditions, this next-to-skin layer delivers superior performance and functionality in the field.

Ideal for extended wear in demanding environments, this base layer provides exceptional durability, breathability, and all-day comfort.

items.name: Bushcraft Hoodie (Black)

Classic Wool Performance for the Modern Woodsman

Built for rugged durability, natural warmth, and all-day comfort, the Bushcraft Hoodie is designed for those who embrace the elements. Whether navigating the backcountry, tending camp, or layering up for cooler conditions, this premium wool pullover delivers exceptional insulation, breathability, and resilience in any environment.

Crafted from high-quality wool, the Bushcraft Hoodie naturally wicks moisture, resists odors, and regulates temperature, ensuring comfort through changing conditions. The relaxed fit allows for effortless layering, while the kangaroo front pocket provides essential warmth for your hands or storage for small gear. The oversized hood offers extra protection against wind and cold, making this hoodie an essential for bushcrafting, hunting, and everyday wear in the great outdoors.

items.name: Op Assault Pant Factory Blemished (Multicam)
items.description_en:
Product Notice – Please Review Before Purchasing


These pants are made with the same high-quality materials and construction you expect from us. However, this batch does not fully meet our internal quality standards. 

The size listed on the hangtag and polybag is correct, but the size printed inside the garment will be incorrect due to a labeling error. Also, please note that although the product's hang tags state TAA, the product isn't TAA-compliant because the size printed inside the garment is incorrect which revokes its TAA classification. 

Additionally, there may be minor irregularities in the garment that are not easily noticeable to the average customer, but they fall short of our strict quality standards.

Because of these issues, we are offering these pants at a special price of $150.


The Op Assault Pant combines durability, mobility, and functionality to meet the demands of any mission. Constructed with abrasion-resistant stretch fabric and reinforced with extra stretch panels at the back yoke and knees, these pants deliver unmatched flexibility and comfort.

A reinforced two-ply seat enhances durability in high-wear areas, while adjustable hook-and-loop waist tabs and oversized belt loops ensure a secure, customizable fit. Designed for practicality, these pants feature multiple pockets for optimal organization and quick access to mission-essential gear.

Proudly Made With US Fabrics

Assembled in Nicaragua

Experience comfort and reliable protection with our Op Top Pro. This top features abrasion-resistant stretch fabric at the shoulders and arms, side zippered arm pockets with loop Velcro patches and pen pockets, and

items.name: Sun Shirt w/ Velcro 2.0 (Multicam)
items.description_en:
The Sun Shirt 2.0 is designed for high-performance wear in the hottest conditions, providing superior sun protection and comfort during extended exposure to the elements. 

Constructed from a lightweight, quick-drying fabric, this shirt keeps you cool and dry throughout the day, even in sweltering temperatures.  Featuring UPF 30 Block Technology, the Sun Shirt 2.0 shields your skin from harmful UV rays while allowing for optimal breathability. An integrated face mask is built into the hood for increased coverage and added protection against sun, wind, or dust.  The oversized hood offers extra coverage for your head and neck, while extended sleeves with thumbholes provide additional protection for your hands and wrists. With a loose, airy fit for maximum airflow, this shirt ensures you stay cool and comfortable during long days in the sun.

items.name: Sun Shirt 2.0 (Coyote Brown)
items.description_en:
The Sun Shirt 2.0 is designed for high-performance wear in the hottest conditions, providing superior sun protection and comfort during extended exposure to the elements. 

Constructed from a lightweight, quick-drying fabric, this shirt keeps you cool and dry throughout the day, even in sweltering temperatures.  Featuring UPF 30 Block Technology, the Sun Shirt 2.0 shields your skin from harmful UV rays while allowing for optimal breathability. An integrated face mask is built into the hood for increased coverage and added protection against sun, wind, or dust.  The oversized hood offers extra coverage for your head and neck, while extended sleeves with thumbholes provide additional protection for your hands and wrists. With a loose, airy fit for maximum airflow, this shirt ensures you stay cool and comfortable during long days in the sun.

items.name: Headwind Fleece Beanie (Black)
items.description_en:
Windproof warmth built for the harshest days in the field.

The Headwind Beanie is constructed with the same durable face fabric as the Headwind Fleece Jacket, delivering proven wind resistance and weather protection in a streamlined cold-weather essential. Bonded with a wind-blocking membrane and finished with a soft Sherpa fleece liner, this beanie traps heat, cuts windchill, and maintains breathable comfort during long sits, glassing sessions, or late-season hunts. Designed for those who stay out when conditions turn, it provides low-bulk insulation without sacrificing performance.

Whether you're posted up on a frozen ridge or pushing through timber in biting wind, the Headwind Beanie keeps your core temperature steady by protecting one of the body’s most critical heat-loss zones.

items.name: Quiver Beanie 2.0 (Black)
items.description_en:
The Quiver Beanie 2.0 is built to offer maximum warmth and performance in a minimalist design. 

Crafted from advanced grid fleece fabric, this beanie traps heat efficiently while allowing moisture to escape, keeping you dry and comfortable in the harshest conditions. The grid pattern enhances insulation while reducing weight, providing a high-performance piece for cold-weather hunts.  The snug fit and low-profile design ensures stealth and comfort during long hours in the field, while the stretchy fabric moves with you, allowing for easy layering under hoods or helmets. The Quiver Beanie 2.0 is designed to stay in place, even during high-intensity pursuits, making it an essential piece of gear when concealment and comfort are critical.

items.name: Women's Frontier Pant 2.0 (Coyote Brown)

items.name: Women's Quiver Full Zip Hoodie 2.0 (Black)
items.description_en:
The Women's Quiver Full Zip Hoodie 2.0 is a purpose-built midlayer designed for high-performance hunting in variable conditions. 

Made from advanced grid fleece fabric, this hoodie delivers lightweight warmth, exceptional breathability, and freedom of movement, making it a versatile piece for layering or standalone wear.  The grid-patterned interior traps heat efficiently while enhancing airflow to prevent overheating during high-output activities. A full-length zipper allows for easy on/off and precise temperature control, while the integrated face mask in the hood provides added concealment and protection from the elements. Designed with hunters in mind, the streamlined fit ensures quiet movement and layers seamlessly under outerwear.

items.name: FLEX Stretchy Jean Short (Black)
items.description_en:
Athletic builds and denim often struggle to get along, but not anymore. Meet the FLEX Stretchy Jean Short- the ultimate jean short made for muscular women. Crafted from our soft, yet durable stretchFLEX fabric, these mid-rise jean shorts are made with 4-way stretch so they fit snugly around strong thighs and glutes without leaving a waist gap. Other features include a fringe hem that can be worn as is or cuffed, and two front and back pockets. 


*Please Note—Denim washes are inherently unique and will naturally vary from piece to piece as part of the finishing process—no two pairs are exactly alike.

Featuring an elastic waistband with an adjustable drawcord and side pockets for functionality, it delivers an easy, laid-back silhouette with cuffed ankles for a clean finish. Crafted from our signature Threads fabric, this lightweight sweatpant offers warmth without overheating — perfect for recovery days, gym warm-ups, travel, or everyday lounging. Soft, breathable, and endlessly wearable, the Threads Jogger is your go-to for comfort that still looks put together.

items.name: Iconic Mesh Short - Stardust
items.description_en: Features: Fabric: Spice Mesh (Nylon/Spandex) Inseam: 2 3/4" Side pockets Reversible in-side-out Waist drawcord Description: The Iconic Mesh Short is a versatile, sport-inspired staple designed for breathable comfort and expressive styling on and off the court. Crafted in lightweight Spice Mesh, it delivers a cooling, ventilated feel with natural stretch that moves easily with the body while maintaining an effortless, relaxed silhouette. This fully reversible short gives you two distinct looks in one. One side features a clean solid design with a bold leg stripe for a streamlined athletic aesthetic, while the reverse side showcases an all-over print for a more expressive, statement-making style. Both sides are finished with graphic detailing to elevate the design from every angle. items.name: Strong Sports Bra - Guava
items.description_en: Features: Fabric: Poshknit (Nylon/Spandex) Support Level: Light Coverage Level: Medium Removable Bust Pads Adjustable Straps Multiway Strap Functionality (halter/keyhole, asymmetrical, or cross-back styling options) Description: The Strong Sports Bra is a versatile, lightly supportive sports bra designed for movement, comfort, and styling flexibility beyond the gym. Crafted in our signature Poshknit fabric, it offers an ultra-soft, double-brushed hand feel with a smooth, suede-like touch that feels elevated against the skin. Designed with a flattering medium-coverage silhouette and center front ruching, this bra delivers a feminine shape while maintaining a secure, comfortable fit for lower-intensity training and all-day wear. Removable bust pads allow for customizable shaping, while fully adjustable straps give you control over fit and support. What makes Strong truly stand out is its multiway strap design. Cross the straps in the back for a soft V-neck, shift into an asymmetrical one-shoulder look, or style it into a halter/keyhole front for a more fashion-forward moment. Built for versatility, Strong moves seamlessly from training to lifestyle, making it a go-to staple for effortless, elevated wear.

items.name: Sculpt Seamlesss Hip Tank - Guava
items.description_en: Features: Fabric: Shape Seamless (Nylon/Polyester/Spandex) Support Level: Light to Medium Coverage Level: Light Compression Level: Light to Medium (built-in shelf liner compression) Top Length: Hip length (12 1/2" from bottom of strap on size XS) Removable Bust Pads Adjustable Straps Description: The Sculpt Seamless Hip Tank is a flattering, sculpting essential designed to enhance your natural shape while keeping you supported through training and everyday wear. Built in our signature Shape Seamless knit, it delivers a smooth, body-contouring fit with a lightweight feel that moves with you. A built-in compression shelf liner works to gently lift and support, creating a naturally enhanced silhouette without feeling restrictive. The adjustable straps allow for a customized fit and versatile wear, while removable bust pads give you flexible coverage options depending on your preference. Designed with a hip-length cut for balanced coverage, this tank layers seamlessly or stands strong on its own. Sculpt Seamless is made for movement, confidence, and a clean, sculpted aesthetic that transitions effortlessly from strength training to daily wear.

items.name: Micro Legacy Short 6" - Onyx Black
items.description_en: Features: Fabric: NuBre (Nylon/Spandex) Compression Level: Medium Rise: High Inseam: 6" Description: The Micro Legacy Shorts are crafted from our exclusive Buffbunny Collection® NuBre fabric, a double-brushed, second-skin material designed for soft, supportive comfort with medium compression. With high stretch retention, these shorts move with you through mobility workouts like Pilates, yoga, barre, or studio sessions, while remaining comfortable enough for everyday wear. These true high-rise shorts fit at the natural waist for average-height women and are a favorite for petites. The micro butterfly tri-arch back waistband subtly accentuates the glutes, creating a flattering, sculpted look. The clean design has no side seam or front rise seam, offering a smooth silhouette that pairs perfectly with matching sports bras, longline tops, or your favorite athletic layers. Sleek, flattering, and versatile, the Micro Legacy Shorts are perfect for mobility workouts, studio sessions, or everyday athleisure styling.

items.name: Revolution Sports Bra - White
items.description_en: Features: Square neckline sports bra Strappy three-strap criss-cross back with metal ring detail Designed for cardio, Pilates, and studio workouts Longline silhouette for added coverage Removable bust pads Details: Fabric: NuBre (Nylon/Spandex) Medium Support Level Buttery-soft feel with light compression High stretch with strong shape retention Description: The Revolution Sports Bra is a flattering longline sports bra designed with a modern square neckline and a medium level of support to enhance your natural shape. The strappy back features a three-strap criss-cross design secured with a sleek metal ring for an elevated, statement finish. Crafted from our signature NuBre fabric, this sports bra offers a buttery-soft, second-skin feel with slightly compressive support that smooths and moves with you. With high stretch and strong shape retention, it’s perfect for Pilates, yoga, cardio, and all-day wear. The Revolution Sports Bra blends performance and comfort for confident support wherever your day takes you.

items.name: Go With The Flow Hip Tank - Onyx Black
items.description_en: Features: Fabric: Limited Edition Polyester/Viscose Blend Length: Hip (21" center front, size XS) Description: The Go With the Flow Hip Tank is crafted from a soft, lightweight Polyester/Viscose blend with a unique semi-sheer pattern for a subtle transparency effect that adds visual interest and texture. Designed for comfort and effortless style, it offers a drapey, flowy silhouette that moves beautifully with you. This waist-length tank is slightly shorter in the back to flatter the small of the waist and subtly showcase the glutes. The racerback design allows full shoulder mobility while maintaining a relaxed, breezy fit. Perfect for layering over your favorite sports bras on cardio days, the Go With the Flow Hip Tank combines style, comfort, and movement-ready ease.

items.description_en: Features: Fabric: Elysium (Polyester/Spandex) Quick Dry Length: Skirt 13" (size XS) Inseam: Built-in short 5" Pockets: Side pockets on interior short Description: The Served Skort is crafted from our sleek and stretchy Elysium fabric, offering lightweight support and quick-dry comfort for lighter-impact activities like tennis, pickleball, or golf. items.name: Airbrush Multi Pocket Legging - Onyx Black
items.description_en: Features: Fabric: Airbrush (Nylon/Spandex) Quick Dry Compression Level: High Rise: High Inseam: 27" Pockets: 5 exterior waistband pockets, 2 side leg pockets Interior drawcord Description: The Airbrush Multi Pocket Legging is crafted from our high-compression, quick-dry Airbrush fabric, designed to move with you while keeping you cool and supported during high-performance cardio. Engineered for long-distance runners, marathon trainers, and endurance athletes, it delivers a sculpting fit with breathable comfort and reliable shape retention. Designed with a true high-rise waistband and contour seam detailing, these leggings enhance and flatter your natural shape. An interior drawcord ensures a secure, adjustable fit, while 5 exterior waistband pockets and 2 side leg pockets provide ample storage for phone, keys, gels, earbuds, and other essentials. A reflective logo at the center back adds visibility and safety for early-morning or evening runs. Sleek, functional, and performance-driven, the Airbrush Multi Pocket Legging is built for cardio and endurance training.

This shortsuit goes from gym to coffee with ease. Throw on a fanny pack for a sporty look, or dress it up with a denim jacket for weekend vibes.

items.description: Pantalones de tecnología diseñados para ser “leose cómodos equipados”, lo que significa que están construidos para adaptarse sin ser nunca resistente a la piel. Fabricado a partir de un material de nylon elástico de alta calidad que es ligero, duradero y cómodo para uso diario dentro o fuera del gimnasio. El tejido ayuda a desviar elementos externos como viento, lluvia y nieve. Terminado con bolsillos laterales de cremallera y un cierre ajustable de la pieza. Orden fiel al tamaño. The fabric helps deflect outside elements such as wind, rain, and snow. Finished with side zipper pockets and an adjustable draw-ankle closure. Order true to size. items.name: NATURAL COTTON PSYCHOTIC CLOWN T-SHIRT - CREAM
items.description: Tee de ajuste relajado elaborado a partir de algodón natural, mínimamente procesado que ofrece un nivel irreal de suavidad. Este es uno de los tees más cómodos que nunca te pondrás, suave y suave, transpirable y ponderado con un drape premium. items.name: AirMove™ Jacket | Coal
items.description_en:
A multi-use, lightweight performance jacket
 Built with four-way stretch for ultimate freedom of movement
 Sweat-wicking tech keeps you dry and comfortable
 Elasticated cuffs so those sleeves stay put
 Back vent aids air flow and breathability
 Branded drawcord at the hem to switch up the look
 Reflective logos on front (left-hand side) and centre of back
 Model (Kyra) is 5'11" (180 cm) and wears a size M
 Our AirMove™ Jacket is the ultimate performance piece, whether you’re working up a sweat in or outside of the gym. Built with sweat-wicking tech and a ventilation panel at the back to keep you cool, it has plenty of stretch to help you move the way you want to. Adjust the fit with the branded drawcord at the waist – cinched or slouchy.
 Due to the light colour of this fabric, it may appear more sheer under certain lighting, or when stretched. We'd recommend sizing up if you're between sizes (to reduce stretch) and to wear discreet underwear. 
 Due to different types of fabrics across collections, please allow for slight colour variations.

items.name: Oversized Longline Puffer Jacket | 70% Cocoa

Product Details

items.name: Performance Knee Sleeves (PKS)
items.description_en:
About Performance Knee Sleeves 
 Iron Rebel® Performance Knee Sleeves deliver the support, warmth, and rebound lifters rely on to train harder, stay pain-free, and feel locked-in under heavy weight.
 When you're pushing yourself to the limit with squats, deadlifts, or any heavy lifting, you need knee support that keeps up with your training. That’s why we created the  Iron Rebel® Performance Knee Sleeves (PKS) .
 We intentionally engineered these sleeves with high-grade 7mm neoprene , giving you max support and stability while still being comfortable and flexible enough to use everyday.
 The PKS offer a perfect combination of tight compression , stability , and comfort to boost your performance and help protect your knees during the most intense workouts. 
 Key Features:
 7mm Neoprene Thickness : Provides the ideal balance of support and flexibility for heavy lifters, bodybuilders, and powerlifters.
 Heavy Duty Polyester Thread : Built to stretch and accommodate larger quads and calves without losing durability. Perfect for athletes with muscular legs.
 Lateral & Back Support Seams : Ensures maximum compression and stability around the knee for ultimate performance.
 Exceptional Rebound : Feel the power with each lift! The rebound feature helps you maintain strong, explosive movement during squats, deadlifts, and more.
 Federation Approved : Accepted in all major lifting federations, except the IPF.
 30 cm Length : Provides full knee and thigh coverage for enhanced joint protection.
 Sold as a Pair : Get the support you need for both legs, all in one package.
 Whether you're training for your next PR or just working to improve your squat depth, the Iron Rebel® Performance Knee Sleeves are designed to help you crush your goals safely and effectively.
 Benefits: 
 Increased Support : Helps reduce strain on the knee joint during heavy lifts.
 Comfortable Fit : The 7mm neoprene offers warmth and comfort without feeling restrictive.
 Enhanced Performance : The tight fit and rebound power you need to move confidently through your lifts.
 Durable & Long-lasting : Built to withstand the toughest training sessions.
 How to Use: 
 Step 1 : Slip the sleeve over your ankle and position it at the bottom of your leg.
 Step 2 : Fold the sleeve in half with the logo facing inward, then pull from the bottom to slide it up your calf.
 Step 3 : Once the bottom of the sleeve clears your calf, unfold the top portion and pull it up over your knee and lower thigh for full coverage.
 Care Instructions: 
 To keep your knee sleeves in top condition, hand wash with mild soap and cold water. Air dry to maintain the material's integrity.
 **IMPORTANT: Do not grab the top seam to pull and yank the sleeves on as this will cause unwanted wear and tear and potentially damage your sleeves. You must follow the instructions to put the sleeves on. Also, please watch the video tutorial below for additional visual instructions.
 ** IF YOUR CALF IS LARGER THAN YOUR KNEE, USE YOUR CALF MEASUREMENT.
 ** IF YOU MEASURE BETWEEN SIZES, GO UP ONE SIZE.

items.description_en:
PR CONTOUR KNEE SLEEVES 
 Maximum stiffness. Contoured fit. Built for serious weight. 
 The PR Contour Knee Sleeves are engineered for powerlifters who demand an aggressive 7mm sleeve for heavy training and competition. 
 Constructed from ultra-dense neoprene, the PR Contour features a specialized contoured shape that allows more room through the quads and calves while fitting tighter around the knee . The result is a secure, locked-in feel with exceptional stability and rebound when the weight gets heavy. 
 Tested and trusted by some of the strongest athletes in the world , these sleeves are built to perform under maximal loads and help you attack your biggest lifts with confidence. 
 KEY FEATURES 
 Ultra-Dense 7mm Neoprene 
 Exceptionally stiff construction designed for heavy squats and maximal loads. 
 Contoured Fit 
 More room through the quads and calves with a tighter fit around the knee. 
 Powerful Rebound 
 Designed to provide aggressive support out of the bottom of the squat when every pound counts. 
 Locked-In Stability 
 Keeps the knee supported and secure throughout heavy training and competition lifts. 
 Heavy-Duty Construction 
 Reinforced dual seams built to withstand demanding training and repeated use. 
 Competition Specs 
 7mm thickness 
 30cm length

 Federation Approved

 PR CONTOUR OR PR KNEE SLEEVE? 
 Both PR models are built for lifters who want serious stiffness, support and performance. The difference is the fit. 
 Choose the PR Contour Knee Sleeve if you prefer a shaped fit with more room through the quads and calves and a tighter feel around the knee. 
 Choose the PR Knee Sleeve if you prefer a traditional straight fit with consistent compression throughout the length of the sleeve. 
 Same elite-level performance. Two different fits. 
 MEASUREMENT INSTRUCTIONS 
 ➤ Using a soft tape measure and keeping your leg straight, measure the circumference of your knee joint , the thickest part of your calf , and the bottom of your quad approximately 2–3 inches above the knee . 
 ➤ Use your knee measurement as the primary reference when selecting your size. Calf and quad measurements should be used as secondary references. If you fall between sizes, size up . 
 ➤ The PR Contour Knee Sleeves are extremely stiff and tight by design and may require significant effort to put on and remove. If the sleeves cause numbness, tingling, or loss of sensation, remove them promptly. 
 ➤ Do not cut the sleeves off unless absolutely necessary. Sleeves that have been cut are not eligible for replacement or warranty coverage. 
 ONE-YEAR WARRANTY 
 We offer a one-year warranty against defects in materials or manufacturing . The warranty does not cover normal wear and tear, improper use, damage caused during removal, or sleeves that have been cut.

items.description_en:
IMPORTANT: We have resized our PR Knee Sleeves. Please confirm your size using the current size chart below. DO NOT select your size based on a previously purchased pair. 
 The PR Knee Sleeves are engineered for powerlifters who demand an aggressive 7mm sleeve for heavy training and a traditional straight shape 
 Constructed from ultra-dense neoprene, the PR Knee Sleeve features a traditional straight shape that delivers firm compression throughout the length of the sleeve. The rigid construction creates a secure, locked-in feel with exceptional stability and rebound when the weight gets heavy.
 Tested and trusted by some of the strongest athletes in the world, these sleeves are built to perform under maximal loads and help you attack your biggest lifts with confidence.
 KEY FEATURES 
 Ultra-Dense 7mm Neoprene 
 Exceptionally stiff construction designed for heavy squats and maximal loads. 
 Straight Fit 
 Traditional straight construction provides firm compression from the quad through the knee and calf. 
 Powerful Rebound 
 Designed to provide aggressive support out of the bottom of the squat when every pound counts. 
 Locked-In Stability 
 Keeps the knee supported and secure throughout heavy training and competition lifts. 
 Heavy-Duty Construction 
 Built to withstand demanding training and repeated use. 
 Competition Specs 
 7mm thickness 
 30cm length 
 Sold as a pair 
 PR KNEE SLEEVE OR PR CONTOUR? 
 PR Knee Sleeve if you prefer a traditional straight fit with consistent compression throughout the length of the sleeve. 
 PR Contour Knee Sleeve if you prefer a shaped fit with more room through the quads and calves and a tighter feel around the knee. 
 MEASUREMENT INSTRUCTIONS 
 Using a soft tape measure and keeping your leg straight, measure the circumference of your knee joint, the thickest part of your calf, and the bottom of your quad approximately 2–3 inches above the knee.
 Use your knee measurement as the primary reference when selecting your size. Calf and quad measurements should be used as secondary references. If you fall between sizes, size up.
 Do not select your size based on PR Knee Sleeves you've previously purchased. The PR Knee Sleeves have been resized, so please use your current measurements and the size chart below.
 The PR Knee Sleeves are extremely stiff and tight by design and may require significant effort to put on and remove. If the sleeves cause numbness, tingling, or loss of sensation, remove them promptly.
 Do not cut the sleeves off unless absolutely necessary. Sleeves that have been cut are not eligible for replacement or warranty coverage.
 ONE-YEAR WARRANTY 
 We offer a one-year warranty against defects in materials or manufacturing . The warranty does not cover normal wear and tear, improper use, damage caused during removal, or sleeves that have been cut.

items.name: Compression Elbow Sleeves (Black Camo)
items.description_en:
Iron Rebel® Compression Elbow Sleeves
 Lightweight Compression. Maximum Support.
 The original Iron Rebel® Compression Elbow Sleeves are designed to provide targeted compression and support for your elbows, forearms, and biceps without restricting your natural range of motion. Whether you're pressing heavy weight, recovering from an injury, or looking for extra stability during training, these sleeves deliver the perfect balance of comfort, support, and performance.
 Constructed from premium elastic compression material, they maintain their shape and compression through countless workouts while helping reduce pain, improve circulation, and provide confidence under the bar.
 Features
 Provides targeted compression for elbows, forearms, and biceps
 Helps reduce elbow pain and discomfort during training
 Supports recovery from tendonitis, strains, sprains, and overuse injuries
 Helps promote circulation and reduce muscle fatigue
 Maintains full range of motion while providing consistent support
 Premium high-grade elastic material that won't lose its compression
 5.5" length
 Can be worn on the forearm, elbow, or bicep
 Sold as a pair
 Sizing
 Please read carefully before ordering. 
 Iron Rebel® Compression Elbow Sleeves are available in ½-inch size increments to provide a precise fit. Proper sizing is essential for the correct amount of compression and support.
 How to Measure 
 Using a soft measuring tape, measure:
 Around your elbow joint
 Around the largest part of your forearm
 Keep your arm relaxed and straight while measuring. Do not bend or flex your arm.
 Examples
 Example 1 
 Elbow: 12.5"
 Forearm: 13"
 Recommended Size: 13" 
 Example 2 
 Elbow: 12.5"
 Forearm: 12.5"
 Recommended Size: 12.5" 
 For an extra-tight compression fit , you may choose the smaller of your two measurements.
 Care Instructions
 Hand wash using warm water and a mild detergent.
 Rinse thoroughly.
 Air dry only.
 Do not machine wash or machine dry.
 Size Exchanges
 Need a different size? We make exchanges easy. Please visit our Shipping & Returns page for complete instructions before sending your sleeves back.
